prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Tocopherol content acts as a partial endogenous antioxidant in carotenoid-rich extracts, with higher initial tocopherol levels correlating with extended lycopene stability, with Pearson correlation between initial tocopherol content and lycopene half-life of 0.82.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-09783","field":"abstract","quote":"Tocopherol content in the same extracts acted as a partial endogenous antioxidant, delaying carotenoid oxidation: Pearson correlation between initial tocopherol content and lycopene half-life was 0.82."}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Work has characterized tocopherol content in press cake streams from a regional cold-press oil producer.","sources":[{"id":"R0922","field":"industry_experience","quote":"She participated in an industry contract with a regional cold-press oil producer to characterise tocopherol content in press cake streams."}]}]}
